title: Create a Session Bar Chart
summary: Bucket session durations (given in seconds) into four minute-based bins and count sessions per bin, including bins with zero sessions.
inputFormat: SQL. Sessions(session_id, duration) with duration in seconds (int), session_id primary key.
outputFormat: SQL result with a bin label and a total count per bin, one row for each of the four bins, including empty bins.
tieRules: Bins are half-open: [0,5) minutes, [5,10), [10,15), and 15 minutes or more. A duration of exactly 300 seconds lands in [5-10>.
edgeRules: Empty bins are reported with total 0. Duration 0 belongs to the first bin.
